[[:Category:Channelers|Channelers]] are those capable of using the [[One Power]]. About 2-3 percent of the population in the Age of Legends had the ability to learn to channel.{{ref|{{bwb}}|Page 18}} This category provides a comprehensive list of all characters who can channel. This category includes - but is not limited to - [[Aes Sedai]], [[Windfinder]]s, [[Kin]]sfolk, some [[Wise One|Wise Ones]], [[Damane]], [[Asha'man]], [[Forsaken]], and [[Aes Sedai (Age of Legends)|Aes Sedai from the Age of Legends]]. It also includes channelers who are unaware of their ability to channel such as [[Sul'dam]] or [[wilder]]s as well as former channelers who have been either [[Severing|burned out or stilled]].

Additional subcategories help break this master group down into more narrowly specific groups of channelers.
